title: FW: Northbridge Payroll: Benefits File Layout Change

fields.subject: FW: ACTION REQUIRED: 2027–28 benefits enrollment file layout change; your file may be rejected
fields.note:
Rejected? Is this why the rumour says payroll is gone? Does this hit tomorrow's 10:00 file?

Half my second shift has already asked me if they're getting paid. I don't know what to tell them. Please advise tonight if you can.
fields.signature:
Teresa Alvarez
HR Coordinator, Joliet Parts Distribution
Ironcrest Machinery Corporation

original.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: 2027–28 benefits enrollment file layout change; your file may be rejected
original.body:
Dear Valued Client,

Effective with plan year 2027–28 (open enrollment begins April 19), the benefits deduction file moves from layout BEN-v4 to BEN-v5. BEN-v5 adds fields for dependent verification status and HSA employer contribution tier.

Files submitted in BEN-v4 after April 15 will be rejected.

This change applies to the benefits deduction file only. Payroll earnings and time files keep their current layout and submission schedule.

Please confirm your technical contact by replying to ticket NP-448120. The BEN-v5 specification and test window dates will be sent to that contact.

This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this address.

Northbridge Payroll Client Services
Client Implementation Team

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The notice is about the April benefits file layout and does not affect Friday's 10:00 payroll file. The BCM should send it to HR to handle as normal and keep payroll-on-cycle at its minimum service level on the recovery tracker. Watch that the BCM does not raise it to the CMT or treat it as proof of the 'payroll is gone' rumour.
